body:
### Summary

Our project supports only two Python versions: 3.10 and 3.13. I am trying to express this in the `requires-python` field with `>=3.10, !=3.11.*, !=3.12.*, <3.14`, however uv.lock "simplifies" that to `>=3.10, <3.14`

Interestingly, if I keep only one exclusion (e.g. `>=3.10, !=3.11.*, <3.14`), everything works as expected

As a workaround, I used
```toml
[tool.uv]
environments = [
  "python_version == '3.10'",
  "python_version == '3.13'",
]
```

### Platform

Linux 6.18.33.1-microsoft-standard-WSL2 x86_64 GNU/Linux

### Version

uv 0.12.3 (x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu)

### Python version

_No response_
title: Double `requires-python` exclusion gets ignored
